name: ndc
title: NDC Directory — National Drug Code
description: The FDA's National Drug Code directory: the codes that identify each finished drug sold in the United States, as one row per labeler, product and package, with each package under its product and each product under its labeler. Each product row carries the FDA's fields for it: brand and generic name, dosage form, routes, active ingredients and strengths, pharmacologic classes, DEA schedule, marketing category and application number, and marketing dates; each package row carries its description and dates, and its product's fields. Read from openFDA's NDC download, which the FDA releases under CC0; unfinished drugs (bulk ingredients and drugs for further processing) are not included. The FDA updates the directory daily and Meridian refreshes this dataset fortnightly, so release gives the date the data is as of. The listings are submitted by the labelers, and the FDA does not verify them: a code's presence in the directory does not mean the FDA has approved the drug. Brand names can be trademarks, which CC0 does not waive.

code.description: The NDC in the eleven-digit form claims and most other data carry, digits only, each of the FDA's three segments padded with zeros to 5-4-2: a package 00002015201, its product 000020152, its labeler 00002. Join other data on this column; for data that carries the FDA's hyphenated ten-digit form, join on code_display.

code_display.description: The NDC as the FDA prints it, with hyphens and without padding: a package 0002-0152-01 (in one of the layouts 4-4-2, 5-3-2 or 5-4-1), its product 0002-0152, its labeler 0002.

level.description: Hierarchy level: labeler (the firm the FDA assigned the labeler code to), product (a drug as one labeler lists it: one strength and dosage form) or package (one package size and type of that product, the level claims carry).

depth.description: 0 for a labeler, 1 for a product, 2 for a package.

parent_code.description: The code one level up: a package's product (its first nine digits) and a product's labeler (its first five). NULL for a labeler.

description.description: The row's own text, as labelers submit it to the FDA. A labeler: its name, the one its listings give most often. A product: its brand name, suffix included, then its generic name in brackets where that differs, then its dosage form (Zepbound (tirzepatide), INJECTION, SOLUTION); the generic name alone where there is no brand name. A package: the FDA's package description (1 VIAL, SINGLE-DOSE in 1 CARTON (0002-0152-01) / .5 mL in 1 VIAL, SINGLE-DOSE).

description_full.description: The labeler's name, the product's text and the package's description, joined with ' › ', down to the row's own level.

release.description: The date openFDA last updated the directory, as its file records it (2026-10-30). The FDA updates the directory daily; Meridian refreshes this dataset fortnightly, so the data is as of this date.

text_source.description: Whose text description is: always fda, the text as the FDA's directory gives it, submitted by the labeler.

corpus.description: Lowercased, accent-stripped description_full: a derived free-text search field, not a source attribute.

labeler_name.description: The labeler's name. On a labeler row, the name its listings give most often; on a product or package row, the name that product's listing gives, which can differ in spelling or legal form from the labeler row's.

product_type.description: The FDA's product type, such as HUMAN PRESCRIPTION DRUG, HUMAN OTC DRUG, VACCINE or PLASMA DERIVATIVE. NULL on a labeler row.

brand_name.description: The proprietary name the labeler gives the product, ending with brand_name_suffix where there is one. NULL on a labeler row and on the few products listed without one.

brand_name_suffix.description: The suffix that ends the proprietary name, such as XR or R, which brand_name already includes. NULL where the listing gives none.

generic_name.description: The product's nonproprietary name, usually its active ingredients. NULL on a labeler row.

dosage_form.description: The FDA's dosage form, such as TABLET, FILM COATED or INJECTION, SOLUTION. NULL on a labeler row.

routes.description: The routes of administration, as a list (ORAL, SUBCUTANEOUS). NULL on a labeler row and where the listing gives none.

active_ingredients.description: The active ingredients, as a list of name and strength (TIRZEPATIDE, 2.5 mg/.5mL), as the labeler lists them. NULL on a labeler row and where the listing gives none.

pharm_classes.description: The FDA's established pharmacologic classes for the product's ingredients, as a list, each marked with its kind: [EPC] established pharmacologic class, [MoA] mechanism of action, [PE] physiologic effect, [CS] chemical structure. NULL where the FDA gives none.

dea_schedule.description: The Drug Enforcement Administration schedule of a controlled substance, CI to CV. NULL for a product that is not scheduled.

marketing_category.description: The FDA's marketing category, the basis on which the product is marketed, such as NDA, ANDA, BLA, OTC MONOGRAPH DRUG or UNAPPROVED HOMEOPATHIC. NULL on a labeler row.

application_number.description: The application or monograph the product is marketed under, such as NDA217806, ANDA078245, BLA018780 or M017. NULL where the marketing category has none.

product_marketing_start_date.description: The date the labeler began marketing the product. NULL on a labeler row.

product_marketing_end_date.description: The date the labeler stops or stopped marketing the product. NULL while it has no end date.

listing_expiration_date.description: The date the product's listing is certified through; a labeler must recertify each year. NULL on a labeler row and where the listing gives none.

listing_count.description: On a product row, how many listings the FDA's directory holds for the product NDC, one per labeling document. Most products have one; where there are more, the row's fields come from the listing certified latest. NULL on labeler and package rows.

package_description.description: The FDA's description of the package, the same as description on a package row. NULL on labeler and product rows.

package_marketing_start_date.description: The date the labeler began marketing the package. NULL on labeler and product rows.

package_marketing_end_date.description: The date the labeler stops or stopped marketing the package. NULL while it has no end date, and on labeler and product rows.

sample.description: True for a package distributed as a free sample. NULL on labeler and product rows.

spl_id.description: The identifier of the Structured Product Labeling document the product's listing comes from, which DailyMed serves. NULL on a labeler row.

product_id.description: The FDA's identifier for the listing the row's product fields come from: the product NDC and the labeling document's identifier. NULL on a labeler row.
